calculation.description: Ranks assets by five-day reversal of returns relative to the daily cross-asset median, activated only when the mean ten-day cross-asset return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-day median. The signal uses data available through the prior completed day and is zero/invalid outside elevated-dispersion states.

validation.regime_notes: Positive at 10d in 2023-2026 (IC 0.163942, 36 dates), near flat in 2027-2030 (0.003982, 514 dates), positive in 2031-2034 (0.034833, 538 dates), and positive in 2035 YTD (0.083813, 18 dates). Sparse activation materially reduces observations; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively.
